column4: Duplicates the political regime meaning in item 3.
The gloss "any content interpreter" is nonsensical and duplicates the existing meaning "interpreter".
'Sentence' as a grammatical statement is a rare sense and overlaps with 'thesis' (a proposition), so it only confuses learners.
The 'mean' meaning does not exist for the noun 'loer' and is a mislabelled adjective sense.
'Stupid' is not a meaning of the noun 'loer'; it is a spurious entry.
The archaic "ill-natured" meaning is obscure and only confuses learners, and the common meaning "mischievous" is already listed.
legal is not a meaning but a vague label, and the other listed senses (excommunication, exile, revocation, declaration) already cover the legal uses of this archaic word.
Lepus is just the Latin genus name for hare and duplicates the meaning hare.
bilingual central is not a meaning of Brussel; it is a description fragment and the city meaning is already listed.
Duplicates the other meaning 'natural talent'; 'natural' alone is not a noun gloss.
Drop as 'droplet' is not a Dutch meaning of 'drop'; the word means licorice, which is already listed.
Ongeschikt means unsuitable, not unfriendly, and that meaning is already listed.
The meaning 'very hard hit' is not a real sense of 'hengst'; it only means stallion (and slang for a strong man), so the example misleads.
The sense 'power of fire' is just the literal reading and duplicates 'firepower'; it is marked archaic and only confuses a learner.
Dolfijn is a noun (dolphin), not an adjective, and this adjective meaning does not exist.
Abnormaal is an adjective used adverbially, and the adjective meaning 'abnormal' is already listed, so this entry is a duplicate.
The example shows the meaning 'to stretch', which is already listed, so 'to reach' duplicates it.
Duplicates the given-name meaning of Dirk; 'Derrick' is just an English equivalent form, not a separate meaning.
Butchering is essentially the same meaning as the other listed meaning "slaughter", so this duplicates it.
Clearing one's throat is not a meaning of hoesten (that is 'kuchen'), and the other meanings already cover coughing.
The archaic manorial-right sense is obscure and would only confuse a learner.
'In poor condition' is an obscure archaic sense that duplicates 'somewhat ill' and only confuses learners.
'Unasked' is not a real meaning of ongesteld (it would be a confusion with ongevraagd), so it does not exist.
Scheef as a noun meaning shive is obscure and archaic, only confusing for learners.
'To rise' is not a real sense of dagen; it is a muddled variant of 'to dawn' and duplicates it.
'To start' is not a distinct meaning of dagen; it duplicates 'to begin to become understood' and 'to dawn'.

This meaning (the 'substance' of an argument) is not covered by the other two senses, which are matter and hypostasis, but the gloss 'substance' is identical to them; since the example shows figurative weight, it is better to fix than drop.
Handbook and manual are the same meaning, so this duplicates item 5.
Opperhoofd meaning 'captain' of a ship is not a real sense and overlaps with military commander/leader senses, so it only confuses learners.
Opperhoofd does not mean 'pope'; this sense does not exist.
Shapeshifting is just the same as metamorphosis and duplicates the other meaning.
The figurative sense 'large group' is already covered by the general 'legion' meaning, so this duplicates the other entries.
Koopje means a bargain; 'sale' is not a real separate meaning and the entry duplicates the bargain meaning.
Intern and trainee are the same meaning of stagiaire, so this duplicates the other entry; the article de is correct.
Het register does not mean lodger; that sense is wrong and the other meanings already cover the real senses.
Facial hair is not a meaning of mannelijkheid; the other listed meanings already cover manliness, maleness and penis.
Overdoen does not mean 'to dominate'; this meaning does not exist.
Overdoen is not a normal word for 'to overdo' (that is overdrijven), and it is not a distinct meaning here.
'Page' as a sheet of paper is not a Dutch meaning of 'page' (that is 'pagina'), and it is a questionable archaic duplicate.
'Selection' duplicates the 'array' meaning (range of products), so this one is redundant.
It duplicates the other meaning "immature", so it adds nothing.
'In a bad mood' is essentially the same meaning as 'moody' already listed, so it duplicates.
Declassifying is a specific use of releasing, so it is covered by the 'to release' meaning and duplicates it.
Kortsluiting does not mean communicating directly; the real meaning, short circuit, is already listed.
Teer does not mean 'act of digesting'; that is an obscure archaic sense (teren) that would only confuse a learner.
The noun 'teer' meaning tenderness is not standard (the word is 'tederheid'); teer is the adjective 'tender'.
Tuberculosis in the old sense 'de teering' is archaic; the word teer itself does not mean it today.
'Certain weed' is vague and obscure, and it is an obscure plant sense that only confuses learners.
The mole cricket sense is obscure and technical, and the word is mainly known as scorpion.
Scourge is a dubious sense of schorpioen and is obscure; the real meanings (scorpion, scorpio, mole cricket) are already listed.
Vicious is not a noun meaning of schorpioen; at most a figurative use of 'scorpion', already covered.
Het jaarboek is correct, but 'annals' is a near-duplicate of the yearbook sense and the example is stilted; the yearbook meaning covers it.
afzien means to give up/renounce (afzien van) and "to cheat" is not a meaning of it; "to suffer" is also wrong, but this entry is simply wrong and the real sense is already listed.
The meaning 'benefit' is essentially the same as the social security and payment meanings already listed.
This is a character name from a literary quote and not a dictionary meaning of the common word, with an ungrammatical example.
The adaptable sense duplicates the 'flexible' meaning listed elsewhere, so this entry is redundant.
Easygoing is essentially a repeat of the flexible/adaptable meanings, so it duplicates them.
The plural 'vessels' merely duplicates the 'vessel' meaning and is not a separate sense.
'Field of interest and action' is not a real meaning of werf (confusion with 'werkterrein'), and it has no example.
'Quick' is not a noun meaning of 'coup' (it is a misreading of the French-derived 'coupe' or a bad gloss), so it does not exist here.
'Tal' in 'tal van' is the noun, not a pronoun, so this duplicates the noun meaning under the wrong part of speech.
Pieper does not mean kiss; this meaning does not exist.
Voyeur is not a standard meaning of pieper; it is obscure and confusing, likely a confusion with 'piepen' (to peep).
The 'comprehensible' sense of vatbaar is archaic and would only confuse a learner, since the current meanings are prone to, susceptible and so on.
Schacht meaning pledge (student fraternity newcomer) is obscure jargon and the example is not a natural general use, so it only confuses a learner.
Luchtpijp means windpipe; 'air shaft' is not a real meaning (that would be luchtschacht), and windpipe is already listed.
Zalf means ointment or salve; the mayonnaise sense does not exist, and the salve meaning is already listed.
completely straight duplicates "following a straight line" and the example is unnatural; the adverbial sense 'downright' remains.
Archaic 'racialism' just duplicates the other meaning 'racism' and only confuses learners.
Duplicates the other meaning 'such'; 'dergelijk' is an adjective-like pronoun and both senses are the same.
The bare 'bass' gloss duplicates the two more specific meanings already listed (instrument and singing voice).
Hospik is already covered by the 'medic' meaning, so this is a duplicate.
This meaning duplicates 'cadres of a political organization'.
Archaic adjective with no example that only confuses a learner.
Through the middle is essentially the same as the other meaning "in two pieces", so it duplicates it.
Seksualiteit means sexuality in general; "sexual orientation" is not a separate meaning and duplicates the other one.
It duplicates the other meaning, 'to settle (debts)', which already covers settling accounts and disputes.
It largely duplicates the 'Arab' meaning, and an 'inhabitant of Arabia' sense adds little for a learner.
Onlogisch means illogical, and 'impractical' is not a real meaning; the illogical meaning is already listed.
'Plumb' is an obscure meaning of the adjective log, and the other meanings already cover the usage.
Uiteinde does not mean New Year's Eve; that is a mix-up with 'uitgang/oudjaar', and the real meaning 'tip' is already listed.
This duplicates the other 'communism' meaning.
The meaning 'instance' does not exist for 'kraak' and is vague; the word means break-in, carrack, etc.
Undertaker is a figurative extension of the person dressed in black meaning, so it duplicates that other meaning and is obscure.
Roeren does not mean to play an instrument (that is 'roeren' only for drums, archaic 'de trom roeren'), and the example is unnatural and confusing.
Firmly is not a meaning of bazig; it only means bossy, which is already listed as the other meaning.
Hard is not a meaning of slak; the real meanings snail and slag are already covered by the other entries.
Churl and oaf are near-duplicate insult senses of bok, so this one repeats the oaf meaning.
Immense is essentially the same sense as unprecedented, so it duplicates the other meaning.
Wijngaard does not mean Virginia creeper (that is wilde wingerd), and the gloss is vague; it also overlaps with grapevine, so this meaning does not exist.
SOS as 'socialist' marked vulgar is not a real common-word meaning, it is obscure and confusing, and the abbreviation is not a standard Dutch noun with this sense.
Instorting means collapse or breakdown, not influx of capital (that would be instroom), so this meaning does not exist.
Instorting does not mean infusion of grace; this meaning is invented or obscure and only confuses learners.
Instorting does not mean inspiration; the meaning does not exist (the word would be inspiratie).
Strife is essentially the same meaning as dispute in item 4, so it duplicates another meaning.
It duplicates meaning 2, as both describe the same festival.
This meaning duplicates the other listed meaning 'to weaken', since transitive verzwakken means to make weaker.
'To be renewed' overlaps with the 'come to life again' and 'reappear' senses, so it is a redundant meaning.
Duplicates the other meaning 'married'; the 'having a spouse' gloss adds nothing.
Bekendmaken does not mean to denounce (that would be aangeven); the meaning is announce, which is already listed.
'To cause unrest' duplicates 'to stir up' and the other stoken entry, so it is redundant.
The meaning duplicates the other listed meaning 'beaver', as both refer to the animal.
'Insurance plan' duplicates the other meaning 'insurance policy', which is the correct sense.
The 'gossip' meaning is archaic and confusing; klapper is now mainly a ring binder or something that is a hit, so drop it.
Greater flamingo is just a species of flamingo and duplicates the general meaning.
Afzetting means amputation only very rarely (afzetten of a limb is archaic/medical); the normal word is amputatie, so this meaning only confuses learners.
The archaic burnt-offering sense is obscure and only confuses learners, and it is flagged as a duplicate of the other entry.
This duplicates the other meaning, which is the same stag beetle with its Latin name.
Duplicates the main 'barrack' meaning, and the gloss has a broken parenthesis.
Archaic field hospital sense is obscure and only confuses a learner.
Archaic and duplicates the general barrack/temporary housing meaning.
The gloss repeats the other meaning (quickie), and the example uses the word in a wrong sense.
It duplicates the other piccolo meaning (small flute).
Koevoet as a wagtail is an obscure bird sense and a questionable duplicate of the other wagtail entry, so it only confuses a learner; the crowbar sense is the real one.
The wagtail sense is obscure and the example is unnatural, so it only confuses a learner; the crowbar sense remains.
The meaning 'of the colour of rust' duplicates the other meaning 'rusty', which already covers both the rusted and rust-coloured senses.
The constellation Corvus is usually called De Raaf only in astronomy and duplicates the bird meaning; too obscure for learners.
The other meaning is also 'raven', so this entry duplicates it.
Vrijaf is really a noun (het vrijaf, listed in item 2); 'ik heb vrijaf' uses it as a noun, so the adjective entry duplicates it under the wrong part of speech.
funny person duplicates the other meanings joker and prankster, which already cover grappenmaker.
Human beauty duplicates the other listed meanings of beauty (a beautiful person or creature), so it adds nothing.
Espial is an obscure archaic word and this meaning duplicates the tracking-down sense of opsporing.
Mouth is not a standard meaning of mik, and it is better covered by the common 'bek' or 'smoel'; it is obscure and unclear for learners.
'Pump-cheek' is not an established meaning of mik and would only confuse a learner.
Stomach is not an established meaning of mik and would only confuse a learner.
'Distress-warrant' is an obscure legal term that duplicates the general 'warrant' meaning, which covers the tax office use.
Assertion and claim are near-synonyms for the same meaning, so this duplicates item 3.
Roet means soot; 'fungus type' is not a separate meaning for learners (only a rare plant-disease sense), so it is dropped.
The bowling 'miss' sense of poedel is obscure and archaic, and only confuses learners next to the poodle meaning.
pieken does not mean "to pick" (that is plukken/pikken), so this meaning does not exist and the real meanings are covered elsewhere.
to stick is not a distinct meaning of pieken and is a vague duplicate of "to stick out".; the entry is covered by the other meanings.
to sting is not a standard meaning of pieken (it means to peak or to stick out), so it does not exist here.
relating to economics duplicates the "economic" meaning already listed.
'various' is not a real meaning of trommel; it is a placeholder and the real senses are already listed.
melken has no meaning 'to play meekly'; the only real meaning is to milk, already listed.
Kleuter does not mean adult; the example only uses it figuratively for childish behavior, which is not a separate adult sense.
Kleuter does not mean minor of any age; it is not a real distinct meaning and it has no example.
The 'capacity' sense of leerkracht is archaic/nonexistent and the real meaning 'teacher' is already listed.
Vitality and life force are essentially the same meaning, so this duplicates the other one.
The online chat platform meaning duplicates the other listed meaning of chat (online conversation).
A hamlet name is an obscure place name on a common word and only confuses a learner.
It duplicates the cautious-estimate meaning, and 'moderate' is not a distinct sense.
'Terrible' overlaps with the outrageous/shameful sense and is not a distinct meaning of ongehoord.
The archaic sense 'language' of spraak is obscure and only confuses learners; the main meaning 'speech' remains.
'Signed memo' is an obscure archaic sense that only confuses a learner and overlaps with the official report meaning.
Intransitive 'to become ill' is archaic/obscure and the example does not really show it; the other meanings cover current use.
Botanical 'pedicel with flower' is obscure and confusing for learners, and has no example.
The causative use 'speten hem' is archaic and ungrammatical in modern Dutch; 'to regret' already covers the meaning learners need.
'Harig' does not mean foggy; this meaning does not exist and the example is invented.
Kruisboog means crossbow, not ogive; the ogive sense does not exist for this word (the Dutch term is spitsboog/kruisribgewelf).
Dutch 'kol' as adjective meaning 'difficult' does not exist; 'kolossaal' is unrelated, so the meaning is invented.
'kol' is not an adjective meaning 'magical'; the meaning does not exist.
The gloss 'object' is wrong and the only real meaning, shelter, is already listed.
It duplicates the other meaning 'diameter', which is the same sense.
Duplicates the 'to cover with planks' meaning; the generic 'to cover' is a vague repeat.
'Funny' is not a meaning of muil, and there is no real sense to fix it to.
'fin' is not a meaning of opbouw; it is a bad gloss with no example.
